clauses.requirement: Where the log-periodic antenna radiated immunity test is performed on the ESA (e.g. rear lamp electronics), use the Figure 1 example set-up: ESA on ground plane with low relative permittivity support (εr ≤ 1.4, 50 mm thick), ground straps, LV harness, HV lines (HV+, HV-), LV load simulator, optional impedance matching network, LV AN and HV AN, LV and HV supply lines, LV power supply 12/24/48 V on the bench, optional shielded box, HV power supply (shielded if inside ALSE), power line filter, fibre optic feed through, bulk head connector, stimulating and monitoring system, RF signal generator and amplifier, double-shielded 50 Ω coaxial cable, optical fibre, log-periodic antenna, RF absorber material, AC mains, AMN, AC charging load simulator, 50 Ω load and AC lines.

Where the closed loop method injection test is performed on the ESA (LV, HV or AC lines, shielded power supply systems with inverter/charger), use the Figure 2 example set-up: ESA on ground plane with low permittivity support (εr ≤ 1.4, 50 mm thick), ground straps, LV harness, HV lines, LV load simulator, optional impedance matching network (see ISO 11452-1), LV AN and HV AN, supply lines, LV supply 12/24/48 V on the bench, optional shielded box, HV supply (shielded if inside ALSE), power line filter, fibre optic feed through, bulk head connector, stimulating and monitoring system, measuring probe, high frequency equipment (generator, amplifier, spectrum analyser), optical fibre, 50 Ω load, AC lines, AMN, AC charging load simulator, AC mains and injection probe; dimensions in millimetres.
The ESA(s) of the rear lamp (e.g. LED PCB electronics) shall be tested using the methods in Annex 10 for immunity to and emission of transients of electrical/electronic sub-assemblies.
The transient test method shall ensure the immunity of the ESA to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and shall limit conducted transients from the ESA to the vehicle power supply.

For immunity to transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, apply test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines and to other ESA connections that may be operationally connected to supply lines; apply the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 likewise; ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.

Emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines and on other ESA connections that may be operationally connected to supply lines.

Annex 11 specifies method(s) of testing for emission of harmonics generated on AC power lines from vehicles; this applies to the rear lamp only insofar as the vehicle/ESA has AC power line connection (e.g. charging), otherwise it is not applicable.

General heading of Annex 11 (emission of harmonics on AC power lines from vehicles): the general provisions of Annex 11 apply only where the vehicle or ESA is connected to AC power lines; no further obligation stated in this clause.
